population.secondaryBandRationale: The immediate superset of the frozen rule, obtained by dropping exactly one term — the marginVariance constraint, which is the newest and least supported of the three. Declared by that principle before its numbers were seen.

actions.homogeneityReason: The frozen delegation rule requires nexusTopRiskAdjustment >= 400000, and the expert assigns a non-zero risk adjustment only to PROTECT actions. The region is PROTECT-only by construction.

nullAnalysis.note: The null re-runs the identical greedy conjunction search over shuffled labels, so the observed best is compared against the best the same search finds on no signal at all.

interpretation.measuredTailRootCause: The entire high-confidence wrong tail is 6 cases across all three splits (4 in DEVELOPMENT). No bounded decision-time rule separates wrong from correct beyond what the permutation null produces by chance. The limitation is not a missing mechanism but a missing SAMPLE: at this population size no rule can be distinguished from noise, so the tail is not separable with the information currently available to the expert.

portabilityNote: Stage 2L.10 through 2L.17 remain DIGEST_PRODUCED_SINGLE_PLATFORM. Stage 2L.18 does not change that.
